name: Education Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Education Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for education solutions.

overview: Education Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Deliver consented inquiries and calls from adult learners exploring degree programs, certifications, trade schools and online courses.

Prospective students often have practical questions about cost, schedule, accreditation and time to completion that they want answered before they commit to an application. Inbound Call programs place program-specific education messaging in front of these prospects and invite them to call an admissions advisor directly, complementing the web lead flow with learners who are ready for a substantive conversation. Callers arrive with a program in mind and often a start-date goal, allowing advisors to assess fit, explain financial aid and schedule the next step on the first call. This channel is especially effective for career schools and programs with rolling start dates.

This product is suited to web leads businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of education consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Adults aged 22 to 55 who are working, changing careers or re-entering the workforce and are considering further education to improve their earnings or job security. The most valuable segments are prospects with a defined program interest and a start-date preference within the next few months, those eligible for financial aid or employer tuition benefits, and learners pursuing high-demand fields such as healthcare, technology and skilled trades.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for online degree programs, nursing programs near me or trade schools; recently laid off or seeking a career change into a higher-paying field; employer offers tuition assistance and the prospect wants to use it; stalled in career due to lack of a degree or credential.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "online degree programs" and "online colleges", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard education criteria include: age 18 or older and a us resident in a state where the institution is authorised to enrol students; highest level of education completed meets the program's admission requirement; specific program or field of interest identified; preferred start date within the institution's enrolment horizon; citizenship or residency status compatible with the program and financial aid; consent to be contacted by the institution captured and documented.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

faq.q: Can education leads be filtered by program and education level?
faq.a: Yes. Program interest and highest education completed are captured on every lead, so delivery can be restricted to the programs you offer and the applicants who meet admission requirements.

faq.q: How is consent handled for education inquiries?
faq.a: Each lead includes documented consent naming the institution that will contact the prospect, with timestamp and source recorded to support compliance with contact and marketing regulations.

faq.q: How do calls complement education web leads?
faq.a: Web leads generate inquiry volume across programs, while Inbound Calls and Live Transfers connect motivated prospects directly with admissions advisors, raising contact rates and shortening time to application.
